proposed_widenings.name: DurationEndTrigger.target_ends_effect_no_action
proposed_widenings.justification: The item grants a timed condition that the wearer can end manually without spending an action; the current early-end trigger grammar has no item-driven voluntary termination variant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The effect ends early if you pull the hood down (no action required)

proposed_widenings.name: DurationEndTrigger.target_ceases_wearing_granting_item
proposed_widenings.justification: The granted Invisible condition is contingent on continuing to wear the source item, and the current early-end trigger grammar has no variant for losing required wear state.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The effect ends early if you ... cease wearing the cloak

notes: The item otherwise fits MagicItemRecord activation cleanly: 3-charge pool, 1d3 dawn recharge, Magic action activation, self-applied Invisible condition for 1 hour. I did not author content because omitting the two early-end clauses would be dishonest.
